notes.ec2/virtual-participant-host: The EC2 launch type runs Virtual Participants on hosts that are billed by the hour whether or not a meeting is running, so no share of the host is attributed to one meeting. Runtime is shown for reference.
notes.lambda-microvm/arm64: Configured vCPU and memory multiplied by the time from launch to release. Snapshot read and storage charges are not included.
notes.lambda-microvm/x86_64: Configured vCPU and memory multiplied by the time from launch to release. Snapshot read and storage charges are not included.
notes.fargate/x86_64: Task vCPU and memory multiplied by the time the Virtual Participant process ran. Image pull and task start-up before the process starts are not included.
notes.fargate/arm64: Task vCPU and memory multiplied by the time the Virtual Participant process ran. Image pull and task start-up before the process starts are not included.
notes.transcribe/streaming-custom-language-mod: Listed as a charge in addition to standard streaming.

notIncluded: Resources that run whether or not a meeting is in progress: the WebSocket transcriber's Fargate service, NAT gateways, the Application Load Balancer, CloudFront, and Virtual Participant EC2 hosts.
Per-request charges of the services LMA is built on: AppSync, DynamoDB, Kinesis Data Streams, LMA's own Lambda functions, S3 storage of recordings, and CloudWatch Logs.
Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base queries (RetrieveAndGenerate does not report token usage) and the vector store behind them.
Amazon Bedrock Guardrails and Amazon Translate (live translation in the browser).
Third-party services: ElevenLabs, Simli and Tavily web search.
Free tier, Savings Plans and volume tiers beyond the first. A private pricing agreement is applied only where an administrator sets its prices in Meeting Cost Prices.
